_about: Rules for sources whose date or origin must be stated the same way everywhere. Checked by tools/check.py on every run; they cannot be cleared with --ack. 'dated': any sentence that mentions the source and gives a date must give the allowed one. 'attribution': any sentence matching 'pattern' must also match 'require' (for claims whose only source is the author's own description). 'identify': in every section that quotes this poster (labels from tools/sources.json), the section must say who they are.

image_forbidden._about: Words that must not be readable (OCR) in any published screenshot: unproven accusations of crimes are not repeated.

hidden_names._about: Names that must not appear in the repository: accounts whose staff role is not confirmed, and players.
